title: Notecard Error and Status Code Definitions

address-assigned.description: Successful DHCP resolution and IP address assigned.

auth-retry.description: Notehub authentication failed; system is retrying.

cell-registration-wait.description: Waiting for wireless service to be registered.

cell-scan.description: Waiting for wireless triangulation (can take up to 2 minutes).

cell-scan-wait.description: Waiting for wireless triangulation (can take up to 2 minutes).

checkpointed.description: Notecard config state has been saved/checkpointed.

connected.description: Notecard is connected to the cellular network.

connecting.description: Notecard is connecting to the cellular network.

dead.description: Notecard power source is in a critically low power state.

device-delay-5.description: Notehub is throttling the device connection.

device-disabled.description: This Notecard has been disabled on Notehub.

dfu-bad-target.description: The requested Notecard firmware is not appropriate for this type of Notecard.

dfu-config-backup.description: Failed to backup config prior to switching to new Notecard firmware.

dfu-dl.description: Too many consecutive errors when downloading the firmware image from Notehub.

dfu-dl-chunk-length.description: Image chunk from Notehub does not have the requested length.

dfu-ext-chunk.description: Error getting a chunk from external storage.

dfu-ext-get-length.description: Failed to get the length of the image in external storage.

dfu-ext-length.description: Bytes stored in external storage do not match the image metadata length.

dfu-ext-written.description: Bytes written to external storage do not match the image metadata length.

dfu-in-progress.description: Notecard device firmware update is in progress.

dfu-int-append.description: Appending image bytes to internal storage failed.

dfu-int-chunk.description: Error getting a chunk from internal storage.

dfu-int-chunk-length.description: Image chunk from internal storage does not have the requested length.

dfu-modem-fs.description: Failed to use the modem's filesystem for external storage.

dfu-not-ready.description: Waiting for Notecard internal DFU image storage to be ready.

dfu-post-md5.description: After booting new Notecard firmware, the firmware's MD5 checksum is bad.

dfu-pre-md5.description: Before switching to new Notecard firmware, the firmware's MD5 checksum is bad.

dfu-sig.description: The new Notecard firmware image does not contain the Notecard firmware signature.

dfu-superseded.description: The DFU was interrupted by another type of DFU.

dfu-total-length.description: The total number of image bytes does not match the bytes read from Notehub.

dfu-watchdog.description: The DFU process did not advance quickly enough, triggering a watchdog timeout.

disconnected.description: Notecard is disconnected from the network.

disconnecting.description: Notecard is in the process of disconnecting from the network.

env-not-modified.description: In response to env.set, indicates environment variables have not been modified.

extended-network-failure.description: Notecard is in a Network Registration Failure Penalty Box after an extended period of modem connection failures.

extended-service-failure.description: Notecard is in an Inability to Connect to Notehub Penalty Box after an extended period of Notehub connection failures.

file-storage-full.description: Notecard filesystem is full. Notecard must be synced to Notehub before more Notes can be added.

file-write-failure.description: Notecard filesystem write failure. Notecard must be synced to Notehub before more Notes can be added.

full.description: Notecard filesystem is full. Notecard must be synced to Notehub before more Notes can be added.

gps.description: The current status of GPS connectivity.

gps-active.description: GPS has started and is currently active.

gps-penalty.description: GPS is in a penalty box.

gps-sats.description: The number of GPS satellites visible by the device.

gps-signal.description: Information about the current GPS signal strength.

host-dfu-fatal.description: Notecard Outboard Firmware Update was unable to complete.

host-retry.description: Notecard is retrying a connection attempt.

host-unreachable.description: Unable to connect to Notehub TCP socket.

hub-mode.description: The JSON request requires the Notecard to be in a particular hub.set mode.

hub-not-connected.description: JSON request requires that Notecard be connected to Notehub.

idle.description: Modem is currently disconnected and idle.

joining-network.description: Notecard is in the process of joining a network.

modem-power-failure.description: Insufficient battery current for modem power-on; Notecard is in an Insufficient Power Supply Penalty Box.

network-error-wait.description: Waiting to retry after a network error.

no-address.description: Notecard WiFi is unable to obtain an IP address from the access point.

no-changes.description: Sync completed with no new changes detected.

no-mojo.description: Making a card.power request without an attached Mojo.

no-session.description: No active Notehub session when one is required.

no-status.description: No status information returned from a connected NTN device.

no-time.description: Network time has not been set or synchronized on Notecard.

not-connected.description: Notecard is not connected to a network.

notefile-bad-name.description: Invalid Notefile name (e.g. may be using a reserved character).

notefile-exists.description: Cannot add a new Notefile that already exists.

notefile-in-use.description: Cannot delete a Notefile that is currently in use.

notefile-noexist.description: Action cannot be performed on a Notefile that does not exist.

notefile-queue-disallowed.description: Specified operation not allowed on queue Notefiles.

notehub-open-failure.description: General error while opening a Notehub session.

note-exists.description: A Note with the specified ID already exists in the Notefile.

note-max.description: The number of Notes in the Notefile has reached the maximum value.

note-noexist.description: Action cannot be performed on a Note that does not exist.

note-paused.description: The `_note_pause` environment variable is set on Notehub to prevent a possible runaway device.

ntn-connect-failure.description: NTN module (Starnote) was unable to establish a connection to a satellite.

ntn-connected.description: NTN module (Starnote) has established a connection.

ntn-connecting.description: NTN module (Starnote) is establishing a connection.

ntn-disabling-gps.description: NTN module (Starnote) is turning off its GPS receiver.

ntn-disconnecting.description: NTN module (Starnote) is closing a connection.

ntn-downlinking.description: NTN module (Starnote) is receiving a packet from a satellite.

ntn-enabling-gps.description: NTN module (Starnote) is turning on its GPS receiver to acquire a location.

ntn-idle.description: NTN module (Starnote) is powered but not actively communicating.

ntn-need-location.description: NTN module (Starnote) requires a location before it can transmit. Skylo requires a valid location to select a beam.

ntn-power.description: NTN module (Starnote) is powered up and available.

ntn-unknown-location.description: NTN module is unable to acquire its location.

ntn-uplinking.description: NTN module (Starnote) is transmitting a packet to a satellite.

odfu-aux-mode.description: Current AUX mode is incompatible with Notecard Outboard Firmware Update.

odfu-fail.description: Failed to use Notecard Outboard Firmware Update to update the host MCU.

odfu-init.description: Notecard Outboard Firmware Update feature initializing.

product-noexist.description: ProductUID does not exist on Notehub.

receive-timeout.description: The most recent Notehub transaction timed out.

registration-failure.description: Cellular Notecard unable to register with network.

request-failure.description: General error while attempting to sync with Notehub.

rts-not-necessary.description: Request to Send (RTS) not required in current context.

service.description: General error while attempting to sync with Notehub.

socket-connect-error.description: Unable to connect to Notehub socket handler.

socket-dns-failure.description: Unable to resolve Notehub IP address.

socket-dns-success.description: DNS lookup of Notehub service successful.

socket-open-session.description: Opening a session to Notehub service.

socket-tls-error.description: Unable to authenticate with Notehub socket handler.

sync.description: General sync status information (check accompanying status).

sync-begin.description: A sync with Notehub service is starting.

sync-completed.description: Data synchronization with Notehub completed successfully.

sync-end.description: A sync with Notehub service has completed.

sync-error.description: An error occurred during sync with Notehub.

sync-remote-error.description: Unable to merge Notefile changes on Notehub.

template-incompatible.description: note.add operation is incompatible with the Notefile template.

ticket.description: Transient error due to Notehub being restarted as part of an update.

tracker-exists.description: Cannot add a new tracker that already exists.

tracker-noexist.description: Action cannot be performed on a tracker that does not exist.

transport.description: General transport status information (check accompanying status).

transport-unreachable.description: Unable to attempt a connection to Notehub.

unavailable.description: Requested resource or service is unavailable.

version.description: The Notecard does not meet the version requirement of the card.version API.

wait-data.description: Notecard is waiting for a WiFi or cellular connection.

wait-gateway.description: Notecard is waiting for a WiFi or cellular gateway connection.

wait-service.description: Notecard is waiting for a WiFi or cellular connection.

web-payload.description: Payload corruption was detected during a web request operation.

wifi-ap.description: Notecard WiFi was unable to detect the configured SSID.

wifi-auth.description: Notecard WiFi connection failed, most likely due to an incorrect password.

wifi-config.description: Notecard WiFi does not have an SSID configured.

wifi-fatal.description: Unable to communicate with Notecard's WiFi module (possible hardware error).

wifi-join-wait.description: Notecard WiFi is waiting to join network.

wifi-softap.description: Notecard is operating in WiFi soft access point mode.

wifi-unavailable.description: card.wifi request used on a Notecard without WiFi hardware.
